Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3.2 Adhesion — The adhesion between the cover and the plies and between the individual plies shall

required to cause the separation of plies shall be as given in Table 1 ( see P 2). 

3.3 Ageing — After ageing for 168 hours at 70-k1'C in a manner described in IS : 3400 ' Part 4)* 
1978 'Methods of test for vulcanized rubbers: Part 4 Accelerated ageing //rsf rev/s/o/? )', the tensile 
strength and elongation at break of the rubber used for the cover shall not vary from the values before 
ageing by more then 35 perc^t. v^

6. IMaricing — The belting shall be marked as follows at intervals of 6 to 12 m on the carrying surface:

c) Letter or trade-mark identifying the manufacturer, and 

d) The number of this standard.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard ( Part 3 ) was first issued in 1971. It had been revised in 19^8 to bring it in Una 
jith the manufacturing practices. Second revision has been brought out in the Ifght of current 
I technical practices followed In the country. Following important changes have been made: 

1) Breaking strength at break of rubber cover has l>een raised, 

2) Loads for adhesion testing have t>een given separately for cotton duck and synthetic pllae, and 

3) Volume swelling test has been elaborated to cover all types of chemicals likely to ccfma In 
contact with such belts. 

The properties of test liquid No. 1 ( sea 3.4 ) are met by Indian Oil's servo Raf oil 3 and Is vary 
close to ASTM oil 3.
